note: The house table of the first Slufter application (src/WorldData.cpp, generated from its survey, the park map and its corrections), exported once and never edited. Coordinates x, y are in that application's own approximation of RD New, which is about 16% too large in position and shifted by tens of metres; positions it showed on screen, and positions given to it as RD, are in the same frame. Lengths and widths are outlines of roofs [m]; azimuths in degrees clockwise from north. front_known false: the front was not known and the side nearest south was taken. Numbers and types come from the park's Plattegrond.

central_building.note: Outline of the central building (reception, shops, pool) in the 'survey' frame.
